description: Wireless Telecommunication Tower Sites Under Siting Council Jurisdiction is a dataset listed in State of Connecticut open data portal (data.ct.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Connecticut. The information presented in this data set is based on records of dockets, petitions, tower share requests, and notices of exempt modifications received and processed by the Council. Coverage: Connecticut. The portal files it under the category Government. Its tags are communication, wireless, tower, cell tower, telecommunications. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: Connecticut Siting Council. The portal shows 2025-05-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ct-gov-portal.
